aliases: 4MP DarkfighterS DeepinView Moto Varifocal Bullet Camera
features: DeepinView deep learning AI (2.5 TOPS, HEOP 2.0 OpendevSDK, up to 4 custom models)
DarkFighter 2.0 low-light: 0.0003 lux color / 0.0001 lux B/W
150 dB AWDR
ShotN technology (capture vehicles/humans of different speeds)
high frame rate up to 2MP@120fps and 4MP@60fps
5 streams
face capture (7 face features, up to 120 faces detected)
multi-target-type detection (face, human body, vehicle)
perimeter protection (line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exiting)
people counting, queue management, heat map, regional people counting
hard hat / PPE detection, on/off duty detection, activity analysis
smart supplement light (IR + white light, 850 nm)
EIS image stabilization
built-in heater and demist
built-in G-sensor for vibration detection
built-in power meter for historical power statistics
ONVIF Profile S/G/T/M
TPM 2.0 (FIPS 140-2 level 2), TLS 1.2/1.3, AES128/256
alarm 2 in / 2 out
1000M Gigabit Ethernet
IK10 vandal proof aluminum alloy body
-Y variant: NEMA 4X anti-corrosion, RS-485, 12 VDC power output
release_notes: Specs per iDS-2CD7A47G2-XZHSY Datasheet, version dated 2025-12-05.

frigate.notes: Deep-learning analytics on-board; events available via ISAPI/ONVIF. Requires PoE (802.3at).

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration (Profile S/G/T/M). Enable in Configuration > Network > Integration Protocol.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'Hikvision' profile. ONVIF supported. Main stream /Streaming/Channels/101, sub /Streaming/Channels/102.
